pairs.evidence: lib/producers/voiceFx.ts:190 A re-voiced ElevenLabs narration take (profile `voice-take`) is passed or failed only on loudness, true peak, clipping, silent tail and a length estimated from the text, so a take that drops or misreads words still records a pass, because no recognizer ever checks what was said.

techniques.evidence: lib/producers/voiceFx.ts:190 The only check against the line's text is an expected duration (expectedSecondsOf). There is no recognizer, no transcript compared to the input, and no natural-recording floor. In packages/domain/src/audio.accept.ts, judgeAcceptance reasons only about LUFS, peak, clipping, tail and length.
